_comment: prism_reservoir/01_single_triangle (2026-09-09): the blazed prism from the STL work moved into an LC reservoir. ONE right triangle, tan(phi)=20/100=0.2 (phi=11.31 deg, same slope as the printed prisms): longer side (base) 15 um along x on the reservoir FLOOR, height 15*0.2=3 um, vertical face at x=15, then 10 um of free LC after it -> reservoir 6 x 15 um (shortened from 25, user 2026-09-09). Triangle is an isotropic n=1.5 inclusion (polymer prism) in 5CB; tangent anchoring on all prism edges (LCrelax convention); bulk seed phi=90deg planar (theta=pi/2). LC: Q3D, three-constant 5CB, no E-field (reservoir conventions), planar theta=pi/2 seed. OPTICS (2026-09-09): wide gaussian beam (w0=6 um, full 15-um aperture) at 550 nm from a 1-um AIR guide; behind the reservoir a 0.5-um air guide carrying the near2far line (far box 160x80 um centred 120 um downstream) and the DFT monitors (plus a full-cell 2Ddft at 0.55). Resolution 40 (8->13 px per in-medium wavelength).

polygons._comment: the prism, rotated so the BOTTOM (15-um longer side) lies on the LEFT wall of the reservoir: vertical long edge spans the full 15-um height at x=0, short 3-um edge along the floor, hypotenuse from (3,0) up to (0,15). tan(phi)=3/15=0.2 from vertical (phi=11.31 deg) — the example_06 arrangement. Tangent anchoring on all edges.

lc_1._comment: LC config v2 (user): director ALONG Z everywhere — code-theta seed 0 (n = z-hat), both phi and theta free in the relax. Expectation: uniform n||z is a zero-torque equilibrium (elastically uniform; the prism's tangent phi-anchoring is moot at theta=0 since the in-plane component vanishes), so the relaxation should NOT move it — this run verifies that. Note optically (2D TE, Ey): n||z presents the ordinary index n_o=1.531 everywhere, nearly matching the prism's n=1.5.

source_1._comment: wide gaussian beam across the full cell height, 550 nm, from the 1-um air guide
